pages.text: Dry nine peyote for three dried pieces. Eat a dried piece, or combine one with two papers for a two-draw joint.
Mix two dried peyote, a water bucket and a compatible empty vessel for up to 500 mB of peyote juice. Use a mod bottle for the full batch or a dry piece in a pipe or bong.

pages.title: In Use
pages.text: The effect can sustain $(l:psychedelicraft:effects/peyote)saturation-powered flight$(/l). Fresh joints stack, and a part-used joint occupies its own slot.
